# PI plan — tranche 5

## Objectives

O1 T7's record is complete and its manifest green, closed by a distinct approver. O2 the
operations gate executes end to end in the suite. O3 the four write verbs are callable and read
back. O4 the live proof is deploy-bound. O5 the tranche's other projects are assessed.

## Plan

S08, T7 (Operations), S06, S17 and T17. T7 is delivered here; the others are assessed against
their manifests and the tranche review decides continue or pause on the evidence.

## WSJF order

T7's accepted deliverables in WSJF order: the gated write set (9/8/8/3), the incident lifecycle
(9/8/7/2), the dual-control policy (9/7/9/2), the governed runbooks and postmortems (8/7/6/2),
the approved mitigation (8/7/7/2), and hosts with the systemic loop (7/6/6/2).

## Capacity and WIP

Six read/audit agents, one build and one live-record writer; two open batches and one open card
per writer.

## Evidence

Project `01a1d039-0d34-7f89-a0be-f3de3c9f540e`, tranche `01a1e9e0-fe45-77e0-993a-d571fecc5ec1`, the journal `docs/evidence/record/journal.jsonl`, and the
T7 acceptance transcript `/tmp/u5a-r9/evidence/T7-acceptance.md`.

## Dependencies

T2 (plan spine) and T4 (contracts and approvals) precede T7; T5 carries the systemic kata; the
live proof needs the deployed operator CLI, and a host must be registered before a live read.

## Backlog refinement

The tranche-5 refinement cadence `01a20ae1-e197-797f-ad84-3fceb90e2645` carries the reordered
backlog; this tranche's order is fixed by the WSJF list above.
